description: This file defines several React functional components for UI elements such as PageHeader, Section, EmptyState, and Skeleton to be used across a web application. These components handle layout and visual consistency for headers, sections, empty states, and loading skeletons.

methods.name: PageHeader({ title, subtitle, actions })
methods.description: A functional component rendering a page header with title, subtitle, and optional actions.

methods.name: Section
methods.description: A lightweight wrapper component for sections with optional title, subtitle, and right-side actions.

methods.name: EmptyState
methods.description: A component displaying a standard empty state with a title, description, and optional action.

methods.name: Skeleton
methods.description: A simple skeleton loader component with configurable number of lines.
